caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, a halved soft-boiled egg, and nori. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a speckled countertop under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark speckled granite countertop with subtle grain patterns and smooth, slightly reflective surface.
The chashu pork is a round, browned slice with a glistening surface, showing tender texture and faint green onion garnish.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible grainy surface and slightly curled edges.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and green onions in a curved bowl.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as glossy, golden-brown, elongated strips with slightly irregular, textured surfaces.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk and pale white, with smooth surfaces and slight moisture glistening on its cut edges.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with geometric pattern, glossy finish, and raised rim.
A pale yellow spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip.
